section-79B-5A.TO: regard A as not suitable to look after children under the age of eight, or not suitable to be in regular contact with such children
section-79B-5A.WHERE: for the purposes of determining a person’s qualification for registration under this Part — (a) the Assembly requests any person (“A”) to consent to the disclosure to the Assembly by another person (“B”) of any information relating to A which is held by B and is of a prescribed description, and (b) A does not give his consent (or withdraws it after having given it)
section-79B-5A.IF: regulations so provide and it thinks it appropriate to do so

section-79C-2.TO: make regulations governing the activities of registered persons who act as child minders, or provide day care, on premises in Wales

section-79C-3.TO: deal with the following matters (among others)— (a) the welfare and development of the children concerned; (b) suitability to look after, or be in regular contact with, children under the age of eight; (c) qualifications and training; (d) the maximum number of children who may be looked after and the number of persons required to assist in looking after them; (e) the maintenance, safety and suitability of premises and equipment; (f) the keeping of records; (g) the provision of information

section-79C-6.TO: provide for any allegation that any person (other than the Assembly) has failed to have regard to or meet factors, standards and other matters prescribed by or referred to in the regulations to be taken into account— (a) by the Assembly in the exercise of its functions under this Part, or (b) in any proceedings under this Part
section-79C-6.IF: the regulations require the person (other than the Assembly) to do so

section-79C-7.TO: provide— (a) that a registered person who without reasonable excuse contravenes, or otherwise fails to comply with, any requirement of the regulations shall be guilty of an offence; and (b) that a person guilty of the offence shall be liable on summary conviction to a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale

section-79D-1.TO: act as a child minder in Wales
section-79D-1.UNLESS: he is registered under this Part for child minding by the Assembly

section-79D-2.TO: serve a notice (“an enforcement notice”) on a person
section-79D-2.WHERE: it appears to the Assembly that he has contravened subsection (1)

section-79D-4.FOR: a person in respect of whom an enforcement notice has effect

section-79D-5.TO: provide day care on any premises
section-79D-5.UNLESS: he is registered under this Part for providing day care on those premises in Wales by the Assembly

section-79E-1.FOR: A person who wishes to be registered under this Part
section-79E-1.TO: make an application to the Assembly

section-79E-2.TO: — (a) give prescribed information about prescribed matters; (b) give any other information which the Assembly reasonably requires the applicant to give. (c) be accompanied by the prescribed fee

section-79E-3.TO: make a separate application in respect of each of the premises
section-79E-3.WHERE: he provides, or proposes to provide, day care on different premises

section-79E-4.TO: be withdrawn without the consent of the Assembly
section-79E-4.WHERE: the Assembly has sent the applicant notice under section 79L(1) of its intention to refuse an application under this section

section-79E-5.TO: knowingly make a statement which is false or misleading in a material particular

section-79F-1.IF: the Assembly is of the opinion that the applicant is, and will continue to be, qualified for registration for child minding (so far as the conditions of section 79B(3) are applicable)
section-79F-1.ON: an application under section 79E by a person for registration for child minding

section-79F-1.IF: the Assembly is not of the opinion that the applicant is, and will continue to be, qualified for registration for child minding (so far as the conditions of section 79B(3) are applicable)
section-79F-1.ON: an application under section 79E by a person for registration for child minding

section-79F-2.IF: the Assembly is of the opinion that the applicant is, and will continue to be, qualified for registration for providing day care on those premises (so far as the conditions of section 79B(4) are applicable)
section-79F-2.ON: an application under section 79E by any person for registration for providing day care on any premises

section-79F-2.IF: the Assembly is not of the opinion that the applicant is, and will continue to be, qualified for registration for providing day care on those premises (so far as the conditions of section 79B(4) are applicable)
section-79F-2.ON: an application under section 79E by any person for registration for providing day care on any premises

section-79F-3.TO: , as well as being granted subject to any conditions the Assembly thinks necessary or expedient for the purpose of giving effect to regulations under section 79C, be granted
section-79F-3.SUBJECT TO: any other conditions the Assembly thinks fit to impose

section-79F-4.TO: as it thinks fit vary or remove any condition to which the registration is subject or impose a new condition

section-79F-5.FOR: Any register kept by the Assembly of persons who act as child minders or provide day care
section-79F-5.TO: be open to inspection by any person at all reasonable times

section-79F-6.TO: without reasonable excuse contravene, or otherwise fail to comply with, any condition imposed on his registration

section-79G-1.TO: cancel the registration of any person
section-79G-1.IF: — (a) in the case of a person registered for child minding, the Assembly is of the opinion that the person has ceased or will cease to be qualified for registration for child minding; (b) in the case of a person registered for providing day care on any premises, the Assembly is of the opinion that the person has ceased or will cease to be qualified for registration for providing day care on those premises, or if a fee which is due from the person has not been paid

section-79G-2.TO: be cancelled on the ground of any defect or insufficiency in the services, equipment or premises
section-79G-2.WHERE: a requirement to make any changes or additions to any services, equipment or premises has been imposed on a registered person
section-79G-2.IF: — (a) the time set for complying with the requirements has not expired; and (b) it is shown that the defect or insufficiency is due to the changes or additions not having been made

section-79H-1.TO: provide for the registration of any person for acting as a child minder or providing day care to be suspended for a prescribed period by the Assembly in prescribed circumstances

section-79H-2.FOR: Any regulations made under this section
section-79H-2.TO: include provision conferring on the person concerned a right of appeal to the First-tier Tribunal against suspension

section-79H-4.FOR: a person registered under this Part for child minding by the Assembly
section-79H-4.TO: act as a child minder in Wales
section-79H-4.AT: a time when that registration is so suspended

section-79H-5.FOR: a person registered under this Part for providing day care on any premises
section-79H-5.TO: provide day care on those premises
section-79H-5.AT: any time when that registration is so suspended

section-79H-6.TO: contravenes subsection (3), (4) or (5) without reasonable excuse

section-79J-1.FOR: a person who is registered for acting as a child minder or providing day care
section-79J-1.TO: by notice in writing to the Assembly resign his registration

section-79J-2.IF: the Assembly has sent him a notice under section 79L(1) of its intention to cancel the registration
section-79J-2.UNLESS: the Assembly has decided not to take that step

section-79J-2.IF: the Assembly has sent him a notice under section 79L(5) of its decision to cancel the registration and the time within which an appeal may be brought has not expired
the Assembly has sent him a notice under section 79L(5) of its decision to cancel the registration and the appeal has not been determined

section-79K-1.TO: make an order— (i) cancelling the registration; (ii) varying or removing any condition to which the registration is subject; or (iii) imposing a new condition
section-79K-1.IF: in the case of any person registered under this Part for acting as a child minder or providing day care — (a) the Assembly applies to the justice for the order; and (b) it appears to the justice that a child who is being, or may be, looked after by that person, or (as the case may be) in accordance with the provision for day care made by that person, is suffering, or is likely to suffer, significant harm

section-79K-5.TO: serve on the registered person — (a) a copy of an order; (b) a copy of any written statement of the Assembly’s reasons for making the application for the order which supported that application; and (c) notice of any right of appeal conferred by section 79M
section-79K-5.WHERE: an order is made under this section
section-79K-5.AS SOON AS: is reasonably practicable after the making of the order

section-79K-6.TO: notify the local authority in whose area the person concerned acts or acted as a child minder, or provides or provided day care, of the making of an order
section-79K-6.WHERE: the order has been so made
section-79K-6.AS SOON AS: is reasonably practicable after the making of the order

section-79L-1.TO: send to the applicant, or (as the case may be) registered person, notice in writing of its intention to take the step in question
section-79L-1.NOT LESS THAN: 14 days before— (a) refusing an application for registration; (b) cancelling a registration; (c) removing or varying any condition to which a registration is subject or imposing a new condition; or (d) refusing to grant an application for the removal or variation of any condition to which a registration is subject

section-79L-2.TO: — (a) give the Assembly ’s reasons for proposing to take the step; and (b) inform the person concerned of his rights under this section

section-79L-3.TO: afford the recipient of such a notice an opportunity to object to the step being taken
section-79L-3.WHERE: the recipient informs the Assembly in writing of his desire to do so

section-79L-4.FOR: the recipient of the notice or a representative
section-79L-4.TO: make any objection under subsection (3) orally or in writing

section-79L-5.TO: send the person concerned written notice of its decision
section-79L-5.IF: it decides nevertheless to take it
section-79L-5.AFTER: giving him an opportunity to object to the step being taken

section-79L-6.FOR: a step of a kind mentioned in subsection (1)(b) or (c)
section-79L-6.UNTIL: the expiry of the time within which an appeal may be brought under section 79M

section-79L-6.FOR: a step of a kind mentioned in subsection (1)(b) or (c)
section-79L-6.WHERE: an appeal is brought under section 79M

section-79M-1.FOR: An appeal against— (a) the taking of any step mentioned in section 79L(1); (b) an order under section 79K, or (c) a determination made by the Assembly under this Part (other than one falling within paragraph (a) or (b)) which is of a prescribed description

section-79M-2.TO: — (a) confirm the taking of the step or the making of the order or determination or direct that it shall not have, or shall cease to have, effect; and (b) impose, vary or cancel any condition

section-79S-1.TO: secure the provision of training for persons who provide or assist in providing child minding or day care, or intend to do so

section-79S-2.TO: have any additional function specified in regulations made by the Assembly
section-79S-2.IN RELATION TO: child minding and day care provided in Wales

section-79T-1.TO: require any registered person to provide it with any information connected with the person’s activities as a child minder or provision of day care which the Assembly considers it necessary to have for the purposes of its functions under this Part

section-79T-2.TO: by regulations make provision— (a) for the inspection of child minding provided in Wales by registered persons and of day care provided by registered persons on premises in Wales; (b) for the publication of reports of the inspections in such manner as the Assembly considers appropriate

section-79T-3.TO: provide for the inspections to be organised by— (a) the Assembly; or (b) Her Majesty’s Chief Inspector of Education and Training in Wales, or any other person, under arrangements made with the Assembly

section-79T-4.TO: provide for subsections (2) to (4) of section 29 of the Education Act 2005 to apply with modifications in relation to the publication of reports under the regulations

section-79U-1.FOR: Any person authorised for the purposes of this subsection by the Assembly
section-79U-1.TO: enter any premises in Wales on which child minding or day care is at any time provided

section-79U-2.FOR: a person who is authorised for the purposes of this subsection by the Assembly
section-79U-2.TO: enter those premises at any reasonable time
section-79U-2.WHERE: he has reasonable cause to believe that a child is being looked after on any premises in contravention of this Part

section-79U-2A.TO: be given for a particular occasion or period

section-79U-3.FOR: a person entering premises under this section
section-79U-3.TO: — (a) inspect the premises; (b) inspect, and take copies of— (i) any records kept by the person providing the child minding or day care; and (ii) any other documents containing information relating to its provision; (c) seize and remove any document or other material or thing found there which he has reasonable grounds to believe may be evidence of a failure to comply with any condition or requirement imposed by or under this Part; (d) require any person to afford him such facilities and assistance with respect to matters within the person’s control as are necessary to enable him to exercise his powers under this section; (e) take measurements and photographs or make recordings; (f) inspect any children being looked after there, and the arrangements made for their welfare; (g) interview in private the person providing the child minding or day care; and (h) interview in private any person looking after children, or living or working, there who consents to be interviewed

section-79U-6.FOR: a person exercising any power conferred by this section
section-79U-6.TO: produce some duly authenticated document showing his authority to do so

section-79U-7.TO: wilfully obstruct a person exercising any such power

section-79W-4.TO: require a person to whom this section applies to hold a certificate issued by the Assembly as to his suitability, and the suitability of each prescribed person, to look after children

section-79W-5.TO: make provision about— (a) applications for certificates; (b) the matters to be taken into account by the Assembly in determining whether to issue certificates; (c) the information to be contained in certificates; (d) the period of their validity

section-79W-6.TO: provide that a person to whom this section applies shall be guilty of an offence— (a) if he does not hold a certificate as required by the regulations; or (b) if, being a person who holds such a certificate, he fails to produce it when reasonably required to do so by a prescribed person

section-79W-7.TO: provide that a person who, for the purpose of obtaining such a certificate, knowingly makes a statement which is false or misleading in a material particular shall be guilty of an offence

section-79W-8.TO: provide that a person guilty of an offence under the regulations shall be liable on summary conviction to a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale
